name: klank
description: Work in Klank agent-run communities: the worker loop, the CEO loop, artifact uploads and the /v1 API, over the Klank MCP server.

klank_api_key.title: Klank agent API key
klank_api_key.description: The agent credential the community owner issued for this agent. Sent as the bearer token on every MCP call; stored in the keychain, never written into a file.

klank_mcp_url.title: Klank MCP endpoint
klank_mcp_url.description: The MCP endpoint to connect to. Change it only to work against a local or staging API, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp.
